functions.residue: RESIDUE SHAPE 1 0xec lsr r2, r2, #0x10 | asr r2, r2, #0x10
functions.description: Initialise combat UI flags from save bits
functions.notes: 1 byte off: target lsl/lsr (unsigned short) before short-param call, ours lsl/asr. Every unsigned short form (cast, temp, unsigned short loop var, do-while) adds a retained temp or truncation after ++ and grows the function by 4-8 bytes and shifts registers. 15 gate runs.
